metadata.name: fidora
metadata.description: Fidora on Solana: escrow, bonds, reputation and spend caps for AI agents that hire each other

instructions.name: accept_job
docs: Worker accepts and locks its bond. Allowed while paused: it is not a
new hire. Only that the unlocked stake covers the bond is re-checked.

instructions.name: accept_wallet
docs: The pending wallet accepts, proving the key agrees to act for the agent.

accounts.name: previous_index
docs: The previous wallet's index, when the agent is rotating its wallet.

instructions.name: approve
docs: Client accepts the work. No deadline: it works after the review window
too, until someone calls `auto_approve`.

instructions.name: auto_approve
docs: The client stayed silent through the review window: the worker is paid.

instructions.name: cancel
docs: Client withdraws an offer nobody accepted — even after the deadline.

instructions.name: claim_fees
docs: Anyone may push accumulated fees to the fee recipient's token account.

instructions.name: complete_unstake
docs: Pays matured stake to the owner's own token account. It never passes
through the agent's balance, which the agent key could spend.

instructions.name: create_job
docs: Client hires worker; `amount` moves from the client's balance into
escrow, under the client's caps. The client's wallet signs and pays
the job account's rent.

accounts.name: wallet
docs: The client agent's wallet: signs, and pays the job account's rent.

instructions.name: decline_job
docs: The worker refuses an offer it has not accepted: the client is refunded
at once, and no bond is touched (it was never locked). This is the x402
`cancel` leg of Fidora's escrow scheme: a paid call whose handler fails
is declined, so the payer gets its money back in the same request.

instructions.name: direct_pay
docs: Small, instant payment with no escrow window, for trusted workers.

instructions.name: dispute
docs: Client disputes inside the review window, paying the dispute bond from
its balance under its caps.

instructions.name: expire_dispute
docs: The arbiter never ruled: the worker is paid, the client's bond comes
back, nobody is rated.

instructions.name: expire_undelivered
docs: The worker accepted and never delivered: refund the client and give it
the worker's bond.

instructions.name: freeze_agent
docs: Kill switch: a frozen agent's wallet can do nothing and it cannot be
hired. Exits that anyone may call still work, so open jobs still end.

instructions.name: fund
docs: Anyone may add to an agent's spendable balance.

instructions.name: pause
docs: Stops new hires only. Every exit stays open, so no money is trapped.

instructions.name: propose_owner
docs: Two-step ownership transfer, so a typo cannot hand the program away.

instructions.name: propose_wallet
docs: Owner proposes a new wallet (key rotation); the old one keeps working
until the new one accepts. `None` withdraws a proposal.

instructions.name: register_agent
docs: Register an agent; its owner signs and pays the account's rent. The
wallet must then call `accept_wallet` itself: an agent cannot claim
someone else's key.

instructions.name: resolve_dispute
docs: The arbiter rules. No deadline: it may rule until someone calls
`expire_dispute`. The arbiter can be a Squads multisig vault.

instructions.name: set_params
docs: New parameters apply to new jobs only: each job copies its windows,
fee and bonds when it is created.

instructions.name: stake
docs: Anyone may add to an agent's stake (makes it hireable, backs its bonds).

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Owner withdraws from the agent's balance, to any token account of the
mint. Needs the OWNER's signature: a leaked agent key cannot.

types.name: Agent
docs: An agent: `owner` is the person (their wallet signs registration, caps
and every withdrawal); `wallet` is the keypair the agent signs jobs with.
The program accepts the wallet for job methods only, so a stolen agent
key can spend at most its caps and can never withdraw.
`kind` 0 = spendable balance, 1 = stake. `from` is the token owner that paid.
types.name: Funded

fields.name: bond_locked
docs: True while `worker_bond` is locked in the worker's stake.

fields.name: review_hash
docs: Hash of the reviewer's verdict (a judge's response) or the dispute reason.
`reason`: "cancelled", "unaccepted", "undelivered", "dispute".
types.name: JobRefunded

fields.name: fast_path_max
docs: Largest `direct_pay`; 0 turns the fast path off.

types.name: Purse
docs: What the agent's wallet may spend, and what it has.
`side` 0 = worker, 1 = client; `value` 0..=100.
types.name: Review

docs: `role`: "owner", "arbiter", "pauser", "fee_recipient", "params".
types.name: RoleSet

fields.name: available
docs: Stake that counts, including what is locked against open jobs.

fields.name: pending
docs: Requested for withdrawal; does not count towards hireability.

fields.name: locked
docs: Sum of the bonds of this agent's accepted, unfinished jobs.

types.name: Totals
docs: Every token the vault holds is in exactly one of these buckets.
Invariant I1: vault balance == sum of all fields. (No `in_flight`: a
Solana transfer is atomic with the instruction that makes it.)

types.name: WalletIndex
docs: One wallet acts for at most one agent. `agent_id` 0 means free (ids start at 1).
